name: Colored Noise sampler wrapper (any stochastic k-diffusion sampler)
plain: Takes any core k-diffusion sampler whose function has a noise_sampler argument (found by introspection; res_multistep and its CFG++ form are excluded because they inject nothing) and gives it a noise_sampler that returns spectrally shaped noise. Each call draws white noise, multiplies its 2-D FFT (or 1-D for 3-D audio latents) by a radial amplitude curve, inverse-transforms and rescales to zero mean, unit std times energy_scale. In parametric mode the spectral exponent alpha moves from alpha_start to alpha_end with progress measured in log-sigma; gamma_matrix mode loads a [steps, bins] table and uses (1 − γ/divider), optionally tilted and shaped, which follows the CNS paper's integrator. eta and s_noise are forwarded only if the base sampler accepts them; with eta 0 nothing changes. Related to the CNS entry, but applied as a generic wrapper.
math:
Symbols: ε white noise; F=fft2(ε); r radial bin in [0,1]; p progress; α exponent.
p = (ln σ_max − ln σ)/(ln σ_max − ln σ_min).
Parametric: α(p)=α_s + p'(α_e−α_s), p'=p or (e^{kp}−1)/(e^k−1); A(r)=max(r,1/512)^(−α/2), A(0)=0 if α>0.
Gamma: A = shape(e^{tilt·r}·max(0, 1 − γ_row(p)/divider)), shape = none|sqrt|power.
n = energy · Z(Re ifft(F·A(r))), Z = global zero-mean unit-std. Base sampler uses n in place of its own noise.

props.params: base_sampler dpmpp_2m_sde default, eta 1.0, s_noise 1.0, mode parametric|gamma_matrix, alpha_start 0, alpha_end −1, interpolation linear|exponential, exp_sharpness 4, gamma_divider 1, gamma_shaping none, power_gamma 1, alpha_tilting 0, energy_scale 1
props.based_on: colored noise sampling (CNS) integrators, per code comment
